Summary: Implement Argon2id user password hashing with salt
Description: As a security engineer, I need passwords stored using memory-hard Argon2id to resist GPU cracking.
Acceptance Criteria: Hash with m=64MB, t=3, p=4. Plaintext passwords never stored or logged.

Summary: Build JWT authentication with sliding token refresh
Description: As a user, I need secure JWT session management with automatic refresh tokens.
Acceptance Criteria: Access tokens expire in 60m. Valid signature and claims verification on all protected routes.

Summary: Implement TOTP Multi-Factor Authentication with QR codes
Description: As a user, I want two-factor authentication via Authenticator app to protect my files.
Acceptance Criteria: RFC 6238 TOTP compliance, 30s window, invalid codes rejected, single-use enforcement.

Summary: Create multi-stage file upload with MIME magic detection
Description: As a security scanner, I must detect true file format regardless of malicious extensions.
Acceptance Criteria: libmagic inspection rejects executable binaries disguised as documents. 50MB ceiling enforced.

Summary: Integrate ClamAV daemon malware detection scanner
Description: As a system, I must scan all uploaded streams against malware signature databases.
Acceptance Criteria: EICAR standard antivirus test string identified as malware with 100% precision.

Summary: Build file quarantine isolation and admin purge API
Description: As an administrator, I need dangerous files isolated from the user filesystem.
Acceptance Criteria: Infected files moved to /quarantine; download returns 403 Forbidden. Admin purge works.

Description: As a security architect, I need authenticated symmetric encryption for all files at rest.
Acceptance Criteria: Files encrypted with AES-256-GCM, unique 96-bit nonce, 128-bit authentication tag.

Summary: Implement streaming decryption on authorized download
Description: As an authorized user, I want files decrypted on the fly without intermediate temp files.
Acceptance Criteria: Streaming response verifies authentication tag; fails fast upon bit flip.

Summary: Build folder hierarchy management with BOLA guard
Description: As a user, I want nested folders while ensuring other users cannot see my tree.
Acceptance Criteria: User cannot traverse, view, or delete folders belonging to other tenants.

Description: As a file owner, I want to share files with VIEWER, DOWNLOADER, or EDITOR rights.
Acceptance Criteria: Strict enforcement on GET, DOWNLOAD, and DELETE based on user email grants.

Summary: Build expiring public share links with password protection
Description: As a user, I want to send temporary public links with password and download limits.
Acceptance Criteria: 32-byte cryptographic token, expiry timestamp, download limit decrementing.

Summary: Implement tamper-evident SHA-256 audit log blockchain
Description: As an auditor, I need an immutable audit ledger that detects historical tampering.
Acceptance Criteria: Log entries chained via SHA-256. Continuous verifier API detects manual tampering.

Summary: Build SOC Admin Dashboard with quarantine & audit view
Description: As an admin, I want a single-pane SOC dashboard monitoring attacks and audit health.
Acceptance Criteria: Real-time metrics for total files, scans, quarantine, and audit chain verification status.

Summary: Design modern React Tailwind frontend with glassmorphism
Description: As a user, I want a clean, responsive, dark/light theme dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria: Clean UI with Lucide icons, responsive navigation, glassmorphic cards.

Summary: Implement CI/CD GitHub Actions DevSecOps security gate
Description: As a DevSecOps engineer, I want automated security scanning on every pull request.
Acceptance Criteria: Bandit, Safety, TruffleHog, and pytest executed in GitHub Actions with zero high alerts.

Summary: Configure Kubernetes manifests with non-root securityContext
Description: As a DevOps engineer, I want cloud-native K8s manifests enforcing sandboxed security.
Acceptance Criteria: Deployments for backend, frontend, postgres, clamav with runAsNonRoot=true.

Summary: Conduct OWASP ZAP automated baseline security scan
Description: As a security engineer, I need automated DAST testing to find runtime misconfigurations.
Acceptance Criteria: Zero High/Medium vulnerabilities in authenticated baseline spider and scan.

Summary: Develop comprehensive security fuzz testing suite
Description: As a QA engineer, I must verify that malicious fuzz payloads do not crash the backend.
Acceptance Criteria: 500+ malformed payloads tested against auth and upload endpoints; zero unhandled crashes.
